payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used for developing per-triple templates, including the use of hand-crafted templates and template generation engines.

claims.text: Per-triple templates were developed using hand-crafted templates for each predicate, transforming triples into facts.
Template generation engines were also utilized to minimize manual workload and control input quality.
The approach may produce less fluent outputs but is effective in managing the quality of input for subsequent processing steps.
